patterns.message: 3D/scroll libraries are confined to src/cinematic/ (docs/11 §7b). They cost 230-280 kB gz against ~30 kB of route headroom, so they must be reached ONLY via import() from pages/home. Import the lazy wrapper instead.

src/cinematic/ must be reached ONLY through a dynamic import() (docs/11 §7b) — a STATIC import merges it into the commerce bundle. Use React.lazy(() => import('@/cinematic/...')) from pages/home. This rule intentionally does not flag dynamic import().
